info.title: Hermes Cloud API
info.description: Public compatibility surface for authenticated clients. Internal Connector and Local Gateway protocols are separate contracts.

basePath.description: Reverse-proxy path prefix without leading or trailing slash

200.description: Rotated access and refresh token pair
Browser refresh session revoked and browser cookies expired; repeated logout is idempotent

400.description: The request body was not empty

401.description: Browser session cookies were malformed or conflicting

403.description: The request was not an exact trusted same-origin HTTPS mutation

503.description: The browser session could not be durably revoked; cookies remain active for retry

200.description: Agents in workspaces visible through active membership
Agents in workspaces visible through active membership
Owner-bound pairing session awaiting fingerprint confirmation
Owner confirmed scope; device proof still required
Device credential activated and initial connector token issued

sessionCookieAuth.name: hermes_session_at
sessionCookieAuth.description: Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Strict browser session cookie; accepted only by operations that declare sessionCookieAuth and their endpoint-specific same-origin policy.

pairingOfferAuth.name: X-Hermes-Pairing-Offer
pairingOfferAuth.description: Raw connector-only pairing offer secret. The server stores only its SHA-256 digest.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated browser request failed trusted same-origin policy

SessionScopeAmbiguous.description: The omitted Agent or profile scope resolves to more than one authorized session scope

PairingClaimUnavailable.description: The pairing claim is unavailable; unknown, wrong, expired, cancelled, and already claimed codes are intentionally indistinguishable

PairingClaimRateLimited.description: The authenticated owner principal is blocked from pairing-code claims until the five-minute failure window expires

Retry-After.description: Seconds remaining in the authenticated owner principal's five-minute claim block

PairingError.description: Device pairing or device authentication failed closed

revision.description: Pairing session public revision for confirmation, cancellation, and status consistency. Never use this value for a device lifecycle mutation.

device_revision.description: Device lifecycle public revision. Use this value as RevokeDeviceRequest.expected_revision.

expected_revision.description: Device lifecycle public revision. This value must equal PairingOwnerView.device_revision, not PairingOwnerView.revision.
